description: This file defines an API endpoint class for managing email configuration settings in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving and updating email configuration data, handling validation rules, and supporting test email functionality.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationAPI
classes.description: API class responsible for managing email configuration settings, including retrieval, update, validation, and testing of email configurations within the system.

methods.name: getEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the EmailConfigurationService instance used to perform email configuration operations.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationService
methods.description: Sets the EmailConfigurationService instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve current email configuration; returns default configuration if not set.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne endpoint (primarily checks for an ID parameter).

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update email configuration and optionally send a test email.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating email configuration, including conditional rules based on mail type.

methods.name: getMailTypeDependentRules
methods.description: Determines additional validation rules based on requested mail type and authentication settings.

methods.name: getSmtpHostRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for SMTP host parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpUsernameRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for SMTP username parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpPasswordRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for SMTP password parameter.

methods.name: getSmtpAuthTypeRule
methods.description: Returns validation rule for SMTP authentication type parameter.

methods.name: saveEmailConfigurationInfo
methods.description: Creates or updates the email configuration entity with current request data.

methods.name: setEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Populates an EmailConfiguration entity with data from the request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating delete operation is not supported.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, since delete is not supported.
